proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 gives Tamil cem-/civa- red with past -nt-, Malayalam cem-/covva/cuvappu/cōppu red, and Kannada kempu. These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These survey paḻ-/paś-/pay-/pag-/hal-/al- responses are comparative old-family forms with ordinary adjectival or human endings; the survey old gloss is preserved, including where the elicited form denotes an old person. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2654 gives Tamil cūṭu heat and cuṭu be hot, Kannada sūḍu/suḍu and Tulu cūḍu hot. Survey džūḍɨ/jūḍɨ, Urali sūrɨ and Irula sūḍānatɨ retain the heat stem with source affricate or rhotic notation and ordinary adjective ending; opaque longer responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
